title.context: Card heading (Insights, Add screen widget): the month's income split into kinds of spending, savings, investments and what's left.

headline.context: Where the pay went: sentence above the bar. Both formatted money. Keep the <b> tags.

headlineShort.message: {income} came in, and {amount} more went out.
headlineShort.context: Where the pay went: sentence above the bar when spending, saving and investing came to more than the income. Keep the <b> tags.

noIncome.message: No income logged for {month} yet. Add the paycheck to see where it went.
noIncome.context: Where the pay went: when no income is logged for the month. {month} is the name alone.

ofIncome.context: Where the pay went: table header, a part as a share of the income.

left.context: Where the pay went: income minus everything spent, saved and invested.

short.context: Where the pay went: how much more went out than came in.

incomeLine.context: Where the pay went: tooltip of the line marking the income on the bar.

incomeLineNote.message: The white line is the income: everything past it was paid from elsewhere.
incomeLineNote.context: Where the pay went: note under the bar when more went out than came in.

fromSavings.message: {amount} was taken out of savings this month, and counts as money that came in.
fromSavings.context: Where the pay went: note when more was withdrawn from savings than put in. {amount} is formatted money.

guessed.message: Some categories' groups are guessed from their names. Set them in Settings → Categories.
guessed.context: Where the pay went: note when a category hasn't had its group picked.

daily.context: Where the pay went, and a category's group: food, transport, household and the like.

bills.context: Where the pay went, and a category's group: rent, utilities, phone, subscriptions, insurance.

debts.context: Where the pay went, and a category's group: loan and mortgage instalments, card repayments.

fun.context: Where the pay went, and a category's group: eating out, going out, hobbies, travel.

other.context: Where the pay went, and a category's group: anything else (gifts, health, one-offs).

savings.context: Where the pay went: put into savings accounts this month, less what was taken out.

investments.context: Where the pay went: put into IKE, IKZE, PPK, bonds and investment accounts this month.
